definition_zh: 亵渎；辱骂神明；冒犯神圣之物
definition_en: to speak about God or sacred things with disrespect
scene: 暴徒闯入圣殿，守门人惊恐地退后。They were punished for blaspheming against the gods.
sceneCN: 这里 blaspheme 是「亵渎神明」（第 1 个义项：以言行辱没神圣）；句意是他们因亵渎众神而受到惩罚。

derivatives.zh: blaspheme 加 -y，义为「渎神行为；渎神言辞」
blaspheme 加 -ous，义为「亵渎神明的」

senses.title: To speak against God or gods
senses.definition: to show disrespect for God or sacred beings in speech
senses.definitionCN: 以言语不敬上帝或神圣存在
senses.example: They were punished for blaspheming against the gods.
senses.exampleCN: 他们因亵渎众神而受到惩罚。
senses.why: Greek blasphemein meant to speak evil, and speech against the divine is its gravest case.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 blasphemein 意为「出言诋毁」，指向神明的恶言是其最重者。

senses.title: To treat sacred things with contempt
senses.definition: to show contempt for holy places, books, or symbols
senses.definitionCN: 以轻蔑态度对待圣地、圣书或圣物
senses.example: Vandals blasphemed the shrine with graffiti.
senses.exampleCN: 破坏者用涂鸦亵渎了圣坛。
senses.why: What speech does to God, action does to His symbols.
senses.whyCN: 言语如何冒犯神，行为便如何冒犯神的象征。

senses.title: To curse and swear irreverently
senses.definition: to use God's name in curses and swearing
senses.example: Sailors blaspheming in the storm were sternly rebuked.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴中以神名咒骂的水手受到了严厉训斥。
senses.why: A holy name spent on anger cheapens it, which is the root offence.
senses.whyCN: 把圣名挥霍在怒气上便贬损了它，这正是冒犯的根本。

senses.title: To revile what others hold sacred
senses.definition: to attack beliefs or figures another group reveres
senses.definitionCN: 攻击其他群体所尊崇的信仰或人物
senses.example: Critics accused him of blaspheming national heroes.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者指责他亵渎民族英雄。
senses.why: The word stretches from gods to anything treated as untouchable.
senses.whyCN: 该词由神明延展至一切被视为不可触碰之物。

senses.title: To violate deeply held values
senses.definition: to act against principles treated as sacred in a society
senses.definitionCN: 以行为触犯社会视为神圣的原则
senses.example: To them, waste blasphemed against the gospel of thrift.
senses.exampleCN: 在他们看来，浪费亵渎了节俭的信条。
senses.why: Secular creeds inherit the old severity toward their own taboos.
senses.whyCN: 世俗信条承袭了旧日对自身禁忌的严厉。

senses.title: To deny or mock doctrine
senses.definition: to reject or ridicule accepted religious teaching
senses.definitionCN: 否认或讥讽公认的宗教教义
senses.example: He was tried for blaspheming church doctrine.
senses.exampleCN: 他因嘲弄教会教义而受审。
senses.why: Doctrine is speech made sacred; mocking it is speech against speech.
senses.whyCN: 教义是被神圣化的言说，嘲弄它便是以言攻言。

senses.title: To speak impiously of nature or art
senses.definition: to treat nature's power or great art with jarring disrespect
senses.definitionCN: 以刺目的轻慢态度对待自然伟力或伟大艺术
senses.example: Building a car park there seemed to blaspheme the landscape.
senses.exampleCN: 在那里建停车场似乎亵渎了这片风景。
senses.why: Reverence transfers from altars to mountains and masterpieces.
senses.whyCN: 敬畏之心自祭坛延伸至山川与杰作。

senses.title: To profane an oath or promise
senses.definition: to break or cheapen what was sworn before God
senses.definitionCN: 背弃或在神前立下的誓约
senses.example: Perjury blasphemes the very court's sacred forms.
senses.exampleCN: 伪证亵渎了法庭庄严的形式。
senses.why: An oath borrows God as witness; betraying it insults the witness.
senses.whyCN: 誓言以神为见证，背誓便是羞辱见证者。

intro.en: Blaspheme comes from Greek blasphemein, to speak evil of.
intro.cn: blaspheme 来自希腊语 blasphemein「出言诋毁」。

items.en: possibly from roots meaning harmful plus fame or speech; the compound's parts are debated.
items.cn: 一般认为由「伤害」与「名声／言语」两词根复合，构词细节有争议。

items.en: blasphemein meant to speak ill, slander, later specifically revile the gods.
items.cn: 希腊语 blasphemein 意为「说坏话、诽谤」，后专指辱骂神明。

items.en: blasphemare carried the religious sense into church Latin.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 blasphemare 将宗教义带入教会拉丁语。

items.en: blasphemer kept the sense of reviling God.
items.cn: 古法语 blasphemer 保留「辱骂上帝」之义。

items.en: English took the word through French for both cursing and offending the sacred.
items.cn: 英语于 14 世纪经法语借入，兼指咒骂与冒犯神圣。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the blasph- root; the near-meaning group gathers words of religious offence.
note.cn: 形近组共享 blasph- 词根；近义组汇集宗教冒犯类词。

entries.definition: the act or words of blaspheming
entries.definitionCN: 渎神；渎神言辞——同根名词
祝福——拼写相反，词源无关

entries.definition: to treat the sacred with abuse
to violate a sacred place or thing
entries.definitionCN: 玷污圣物——只及物，不及言辞
诽谤—— secular 化的「恶言」

normalIntro.en: Blaspheme is Greek, to speak evil of, aimed at God.
normalIntro.cn: blaspheme 源自希腊语「出言诋毁」，对象直指神明。

normal.en: It pairs with against: blaspheme against God.
normal.cn: 常与 against 搭配：blaspheme against God。

normal.en: It can be used both transitively and intransitively.
normal.cn: 它可作及物或不及物动词。

normal.en: Serious blasphemy was once a crime.
normal.cn: 严重的渎神行为曾属犯罪。

abstract.en: See a fist shaken at the sky during thunder.
abstract.cn: 看雷声中一只向天空挥舞的拳头。

abstract.en: Feel the silence after a holy name is spat out.
abstract.cn: 感受圣名被吐出后那一刻的死寂。

abstract.en: Picture a shrine wall scarred by spray paint.
abstract.cn: 想象被喷漆划伤的圣坛墙壁。

examples.en: They were punished for blaspheming against the gods.
examples.cn: 他们因亵渎众神而受到惩罚。

examples.en: Sailors blaspheming in the storm were sternly rebuked.
examples.cn: 风暴中以神名咒骂的水手受到了严厉训斥。

examples.en: He was tried for blaspheming church doctrine.
examples.cn: 他因嘲弄教会教义而受审。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不给脸」——神明不给脸面、出言冒犯，便是亵渎。

root: 希腊语 blasphemein「出言诋毁」（一般认为由表「伤害」的词根与表「言语／名声」的词根复合，构词细节有争议），经晚期拉丁语 blasphemare 与古法语 blasphemer，14 世纪进入英语，义为「亵渎；辱骂神明」。

sensesIntro.en: From reviling gods to violating secular taboos, blaspheme marks speech and act against the sacred.
sensesIntro.cn: 从辱骂神明到触犯世俗禁忌，blaspheme 标记针对神圣的言行。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: spit thrown at the face of an idol
core.cn: 核心意象：吐向神像的一口唾沫

branches.en: Words aimed at God and doctrine
branches.cn: 指向神明与教义的言辞

branches.en: Acts against holy places and revered things
branches.cn: 针对圣地与尊崇之物的行为
对他者尊崇之物的攻击

intro.en: The blasph- root builds a tight English family.
intro.cn: blasph- 词根构成一个紧凑的英语词族。

latinIntro.en: Greek root via Latin and French.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词根经拉丁语与法语传入。
